newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh SEC moves tough against stock fraud.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh SEC moves tough against stock fraud.

text.p: Bangladesh's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Wednesday filed cases against 15 companies and some leading brokers and dealers after an inquiry into market manipulation, the official BSS news agency said.
It said the cases were filed at the court of Dhaka's chief metropolitan magistrate "on the basis of a report of a four-member inquiry committtee headed by Professor Aminul Islam Chowdhury."
The inquiry committee was formed on December 26 after stock prices started falling following four consecutive months of rising prices, triggering panic and unrest in the capital market.
The DSE benchmark index fell to 1,225.49 on Wednesday from 3,600 in the first week of October.
The report said it found "systematic deficiencies" in the operations of securities market.
